name: Counter Strike
strategy: Respond to enemy aggression through timely defense and retaliation.

commands.name: Measured Retaliation
commands.effect: After a friendly Unit survives an enemy Engagement Attack, its next Engagement Attack against that attacker gains +2 Attacks. The benefit expires after its next Combat activation.

commands.name: Parry and Return
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Tough 2 against an incoming Engagement Attack. If it suffers no unsaved Damage, its next Engagement Attack against that attacker gains Accurate 1.

commands.name: Countermand
commands.effect: When an enemy attacks a friendly Unit within Short of friendly Headquarters, discard one successful non-6 Hit die from that Attack after Hit rerolls and before saves.

commands.name: Return Volley
commands.effect: After a friendly Unit survives a ranged Attack, its next ranged Attack against the attacker gains Accurate 2 and Pinpoint. The effect expires after its next Assault activation.

commands.name: Emergency Screen
commands.effect: When a friendly Unit within 2" of a different friendly Unit is attacked, reduce the incoming Attack by one Attack die, minimum one, before rolling to Hit.

doctrineIdentity: Defensive reactions followed by opportunities to retaliate. Unlike Castling, Counter Strike does not require advance preparation or holding a position.
